name: DS Cluster S10: Resampling (downsample + upsample)
description: Tests: downsample from 1D to 1W/1M with how=last/sum/max. Correct option name is 'how' not 'agg'.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S10: Resampling
# =============================================================================
# resample(series, target_timeframe=..., agg=["Last"])
# Option is 'how', NOT 'agg'. Enum is NumericDownsampleAgg, NOT AggregationType.

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v
rets = returns(close)

# === DOWNSAMPLE: daily → weekly ===
weekly_close = resample(close, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Last"])
weekly_volume = resample(volume, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Sum"])
weekly_high = resample(src.h, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Max"])

# === DOWNSAMPLE: daily → monthly ===
monthly_close = resample(close, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Last"])
monthly_ret = resample(rets, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Sum"])

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Weekly vs Daily Close",
    category="Resampling",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Daily", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Weekly (Last)", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, weekly_close))

xy_lines(
    title="Monthly Returns (sum of daily)",
    category="Resampling",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Monthly Return", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=monthly_ret)
